items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: the deal was made then that with Cosmo, Dave Othlame wasn't there, but he was part of it, with the Griffin Brothers.

ctx.x: I think one of these black or white musicians?

Black musicians. Well, in New York, they don't know about what's going on down here. And so we recorded a jungle-up version of Tra-La-La. And I stayed in New York. The only time I saw Cosmo was when I was in the studio, because I stayed at a hotel downtown New York. I forgot the name of the hotel, but it was downtown. Cosmo had relatives in New York, so he stayed by the hotel. And the only time I saw Cosmo was when I recorded and after that I didn't see him. But the deal was made then that with Cosmo, Dave…
So I was sold out. So the reason for you to go to New York wasn't for you to record the song.
